quests.dispatcherQuestion: A fire has broken out on the eighth floor of a twenty-story office tower during working hours. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the specific type of fire alert that raises resources.
quests.explanation: Declaring it a high-rise fire brings the extra ladder trucks and crews such tall buildings require.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Some staff above the eighth floor are unsure whether to use the stairs or wait. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the clear instruction they need right now.
quests.explanation: Clear direction to the stairs stops confusion and prevents anyone from waiting for a lift that isn't safe to use.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Firefighters confirm the blaze is contained to one floor and fully under control. Input code!
quests.hint: Say how people should be let back in, floor by floor.
quests.explanation: A staged return floor by floor avoids overcrowding the lobby and lets crews confirm each area is safe first.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A multi-vehicle crash on a city bypass has left fuel leaking across two lanes. Input code!
quests.hint: Say exactly how much of the road must shut.
quests.explanation: Closing both lanes, not just one, keeps drivers away from fuel that could ignite from a single spark.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Crews need to stop the leaking fuel from reaching a nearby storm drain. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the action needed to stop it spreading further.
quests.explanation: Containing the spill prevents fuel from entering the drainage system and causing wider environmental harm.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The spill is contained and paramedics confirm all drivers have only minor injuries. Input code!
quests.hint: Say how the road should reopen, one step at a time.
quests.explanation: Reopening gradually lets traffic flow again while crews finish clearing the second lane safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A city hospital's emergency department is at full capacity after a multi-car pileup on the ring road. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to patients not yet arrived.
quests.explanation: Diverting new arrivals to another hospital ensures everyone gets timely care instead of waiting in an overloaded department.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Off-duty nurses and doctors are asked to come in and help manage the surge. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what additional resource the hospital needs.
quests.explanation: Extra staff let the department safely treat more patients at once during the busiest hours.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The surge has eased and the department is back to its normal patient flow. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can return to how it was before.
quests.explanation: Resuming normal intake means new patients no longer need to be sent to another hospital.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A city-wide storm has brought down dozens of trees, blocking several main roads at once. Input code!
quests.hint: Say which roads should be cleared first, and why.
quests.explanation: Clearing routes to hospitals first ensures ambulances can keep reaching patients while other roads wait their turn.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Crews have limited chainsaws and need to decide which blocked road to clear next. Input code!
quests.hint: Say which type of route matters most after hospitals.
quests.explanation: Clearing routes near schools next helps parents reach children and buses get through safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All main roads are now clear and the storm has fully passed the city. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen now the emergency has ended.
quests.explanation: Standing the response down once roads are clear frees crews to return to normal duties.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large apartment complex has lost heating in freezing temperatures, and several residents are elderly. Input code!
quests.hint: Say which residents need checking on first.
quests.explanation: Checking on elderly residents first protects those most at risk from cold-related illness while repairs are made.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers confirm the building's heating system needs a part that won't arrive until tomorrow. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what temporary equipment residents need immediately.
quests.explanation: Temporary heaters keep residents safe overnight while they wait for the proper repair the next day.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The replacement part has arrived and engineers confirm the heating system is fully working again. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the temporary equipment now.
quests.explanation: Collecting the heaters once real heating is restored frees them for the next building that may need them.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A city marathon has runners collapsing from heat exhaustion at three separate points along the route. Input code!
quests.hint: Say how medical help should be spread across the route.
quests.explanation: Sending a team to each point means runners at every location get help without waiting for one team to travel between them.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Organizers need to warn remaining runners about the rising midday heat before more collapse. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be broadcast to runners still on the course.
quests.explanation: A clear warning lets runners still on the course slow down or seek water before they're also affected.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Organizers decide the safest choice is to shorten the race for everyone still running. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what route change should be announced.
quests.explanation: Redirecting to a shorter finish protects the remaining runners without needing to cancel the event entirely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large concert venue reports its main power supply has failed during a sold-out evening show. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what secondary supply should activate.
quests.explanation: Backup power keeps emergency lighting and exit signs working so the crowd can leave safely if needed.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Backup power only covers emergency lighting, not the sound system needed to update the crowd. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what simple equipment staff can use instead.
quests.explanation: Megaphones let staff give clear instructions to the crowd even without the main sound system working.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers restore full power and confirm every system in the venue is working normally. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can now happen once everything is confirmed working.
quests.explanation: Resuming only after full confirmation means the crowd doesn't face another sudden power failure mid-show.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A shipping container has fallen from a crane at the docks, blocking the only access road. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed to move something this large.
quests.explanation: Only heavy lifting equipment can safely move a fallen shipping container without further risk to workers nearby.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Dock workers report the container may contain hazardous chemicals based on its shipping label. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the specialist team trained for dangerous materials.
quests.explanation: A hazmat team can safely check the container's contents before anyone else works near it.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The hazmat team confirms the container holds only packaged machine parts, nothing dangerous. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen once the container is confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Clearing the road can now proceed safely, since the contents pose no chemical risk to workers.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A residential tower's only working elevator has trapped six people between floors during a fire drill. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the specialist team trained for this.
quests.explanation: A specialist elevator rescue team knows how to safely open the doors without the car suddenly moving.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Building management confirms this was a real fault, not part of the planned drill. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the elevator once repaired.
quests.explanation: Taking it offline until fully repaired prevents the same fault from trapping anyone else.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All six people have been safely freed and are being checked for any injuries. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what team can treat minor injuries on site.
quests.explanation: First aid staff can calmly check everyone after a frightening experience, even if no one appears hurt.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A city-center protest has grown larger than expected and is blocking a main intersection. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to traffic near the crowd.
quests.explanation: Rerouting traffic keeps drivers and the crowd apart, reducing the risk of anyone being hurt near vehicles.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Organizers confirm the gathering is peaceful, and officers are asked to maintain a calm presence. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the tone officers should keep while monitoring.
quests.explanation: A light, visible presence keeps the peaceful gathering safe without creating unnecessary tension.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The crowd has dispersed peacefully by early evening as planned. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the crowd has left.
quests.explanation: Reopening the intersection once the crowd is gone lets normal traffic flow return to the area.
